pinterest.description: What does a human verification gate actually do? It pauses an automated workflow at a defined point, presents the evidence and requires a named person to decide whether the workflow may continue. The AI does not approve its own work. See the Sapiver Forge AI Workflow Control Gate.Link in bio.#SapiverForge #HumanInTheLoop #AIGovernance #ResponsibleAI
